title: Huge disappointment, not worth the money
text: First box I received was just okay. A little disappointed, but willing to hang in there. Second box that came in December was a huge disappointment. Chiefly made toys, that came apart easily, one had a bell that came off in my hand as I removed it from the box, huge safety issue for any pet who could choke on this. Christmas stocking was cute and little pouch of cat treats were okay I guess but a total of $44 for 2 usable items? Box cat, you could do much better. I'd rather receive two or three high quality items then several little things that are cheap and not usable. There was a big felt type Christmas tree thing with flaps that you were supposed to hide and treats under. They also had little tiny fuzzy balls on them that any cat or dog could and probably would have pulled off easily, another safety issue. Who on Earth comes up with these things? Canceling my subscription today
label: negative
